from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    colors=set(v for row in grid for v in row if v)
    frames=[]
    frame_colors=set()
    for color in colors:
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        if len(cells)<8: continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        perimeter=2*(r1-r0+1)+2*(c1-c0+1)-4
        if len(cells)!=perimeter or r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
        good=True
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                edge=r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1)
                if edge and grid[r][c]!=color: good=False
                if not edge and grid[r][c]!=0: good=False
        if good:
            frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1)); frame_colors.add(color)
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v and v not in frame_colors)
    out=[[v if v in frame_colors else 0 for v in row] for row in grid]
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1 in frames:
        ir0,ir1,ic0,ic1=r0+1,r1-1,c0+1,c1-1
        parity=(ir0+ic0)%2
        needed=sum(1 for r in range(ir0,ir1+1) for c in range(ic0,ic1+1) if (r+c)%2==parity)
        fill_color=next((col for col,n in counts.items() if n==needed),None)
        if fill_color is not None:
            for r in range(ir0,ir1+1):
                for c in range(ic0,ic1+1):
                    if (r+c)%2==parity: out[r][c]=fill_color
    return out
